scripts.label: Open, high-event game
scripts.summary: Chances flow both ways and the scoreboard keeps moving: eight or more goals.
scripts.needs: Both offenses generate quality chances and the goaltending does not hold.
scripts.breaks: Either goalie settles in, or one team shuts the game down after taking a lead.
scripts.rule: >= 8 non-shootout goals

scripts.label: Back-and-forth game
scripts.summary: A normal-scoring game with roughly even play, usually decided late or by one goal.
scripts.needs: Neither team establishes sustained control, and the score stays within reach.
scripts.breaks: Any team pulling clear with territorial control, a goalie steal, or a power-play barrage.
scripts.rule: everything not matched above (the explicit catch-all; no hidden 'other' bucket)

scripts.label: COL controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: COL holds the territorial edge on the road and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: COL out-chances TOR and converts enough to pull clear.
scripts.breaks: TOR's goalie stealing it, or TOR keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: away wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

scripts.label: Special teams decide it
scripts.summary: Power plays drive the scoring: one side converts repeatedly with the man advantage.
scripts.needs: Penalties pile up and one power play converts at least twice.
scripts.breaks: A clean, low-penalty game decided at even strength.
scripts.rule: a team scores >= 2 power-play goals and they are at least half of its goals

scripts.label: Tight, low-event game
scripts.summary: Few chances, strong goaltending, and a one-goal or overtime finish with four goals or fewer.
scripts.needs: Both teams defend well and neither power play converts much.
scripts.breaks: An early multi-goal lead, or either team's finishing running hot.
scripts.rule: <= 4 non-shootout goals and a one-goal final or overtime

scripts.label: Goaltending steals it
scripts.summary: One team is clearly out-shot and wins anyway behind its goaltender or opportunistic finishing.
scripts.needs: The out-shot team's goalie stops nearly everything and it converts its few chances.
scripts.breaks: The team with the territorial edge simply converts its shot volume.
scripts.rule: the winner had <= 42% of the shots on goal

scripts.label: TOR controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: TOR holds the territorial edge and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: TOR out-chances COL and converts enough to pull clear (an empty-net goal often seals it).
scripts.breaks: COL's goalie stealing it, or COL keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: home wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

tiers.ROBUST: adjusted EV >= 0.02 and mass survived >= 0.65 and >= 3 major scripts survived
tiers.MODERATE: adjusted EV >= 0.01 and mass survived >= 0.45 and >= 2 major scripts survived
tiers.FRAGILE: adjusted EV > 0 but below the MODERATE thresholds
tiers.DOES_NOT_SURVIVE: adjusted EV <= 0 at the executable ask
tiers.UNAVAILABLE: no executable ask, stale or crossed board, or not pregame

rules.ordering: data quality OK > not REJECTED > not FRAGILE > research score; research score = adjusted EV (c) x (0.5 + mass survived) x reliability weight x dependency factor x liquidity factor x exposure factor (x1.10 if FUNDED_RESEARCH)

taxonomy.partition: mutually exclusive by precedence; probabilities are integer draw counts and sum to 1

thresholds.provenance: a priori; aligned with thesis.scripts cut points; base rates 8-25% on 2022-23..2025-26 official finals; never fit to a slate

base_rates.source: official NHL finals (data/history/nhl games + data/history/players goals/goalies), completed regular seasons only

taxonomy.caveat: simulated shot volume comes from the goalie-saves layer with muted score effects; GOALIE_DRIVEN is expected to be under-forecast relative to history. The script calibration report measures it.

rules.conservative_probability: p_adjusted = mid + k (p - mid) (thesis.expression); per-script EV subtracts delta = p - p_adjusted from P(side | script)

scripts.label: Back-and-forth game
scripts.summary: A normal-scoring game with roughly even play, usually decided late or by one goal.
scripts.needs: Neither team establishes sustained control, and the score stays within reach.
scripts.breaks: Any team pulling clear with territorial control, a goalie steal, or a power-play barrage.
scripts.rule: everything not matched above (the explicit catch-all; no hidden 'other' bucket)

scripts.label: Open, high-event game
scripts.summary: Chances flow both ways and the scoreboard keeps moving: eight or more goals.
scripts.needs: Both offenses generate quality chances and the goaltending does not hold.
scripts.breaks: Either goalie settles in, or one team shuts the game down after taking a lead.
scripts.rule: >= 8 non-shootout goals

scripts.label: Special teams decide it
scripts.summary: Power plays drive the scoring: one side converts repeatedly with the man advantage.
scripts.needs: Penalties pile up and one power play converts at least twice.
scripts.breaks: A clean, low-penalty game decided at even strength.
scripts.rule: a team scores >= 2 power-play goals and they are at least half of its goals

scripts.label: MIN controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: MIN holds the territorial edge on the road and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: MIN out-chances MTL and converts enough to pull clear.
scripts.breaks: MTL's goalie stealing it, or MTL keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: away wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

scripts.label: Tight, low-event game
scripts.summary: Few chances, strong goaltending, and a one-goal or overtime finish with four goals or fewer.
scripts.needs: Both teams defend well and neither power play converts much.
scripts.breaks: An early multi-goal lead, or either team's finishing running hot.
scripts.rule: <= 4 non-shootout goals and a one-goal final or overtime

scripts.label: MTL controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: MTL holds the territorial edge and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: MTL out-chances MIN and converts enough to pull clear (an empty-net goal often seals it).
scripts.breaks: MIN's goalie stealing it, or MIN keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: home wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

scripts.label: Goaltending steals it
scripts.summary: One team is clearly out-shot and wins anyway behind its goaltender or opportunistic finishing.
scripts.needs: The out-shot team's goalie stops nearly everything and it converts its few chances.
scripts.breaks: The team with the territorial edge simply converts its shot volume.
scripts.rule: the winner had <= 42% of the shots on goal

tiers.MODERATE: adjusted EV >= 0.01 and mass survived >= 0.45 and >= 2 major scripts survived

scripts.label: Back-and-forth game
scripts.summary: A normal-scoring game with roughly even play, usually decided late or by one goal.
scripts.needs: Neither team establishes sustained control, and the score stays within reach.
scripts.breaks: Any team pulling clear with territorial control, a goalie steal, or a power-play barrage.
scripts.rule: everything not matched above (the explicit catch-all; no hidden 'other' bucket)

scripts.label: Open, high-event game
scripts.summary: Chances flow both ways and the scoreboard keeps moving: eight or more goals.
scripts.needs: Both offenses generate quality chances and the goaltending does not hold.
scripts.breaks: Either goalie settles in, or one team shuts the game down after taking a lead.
scripts.rule: >= 8 non-shootout goals

scripts.label: OTT controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: OTT holds the territorial edge and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: OTT out-chances WSH and converts enough to pull clear (an empty-net goal often seals it).
scripts.breaks: WSH's goalie stealing it, or WSH keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: home wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

scripts.label: Special teams decide it
scripts.summary: Power plays drive the scoring: one side converts repeatedly with the man advantage.
scripts.needs: Penalties pile up and one power play converts at least twice.
scripts.breaks: A clean, low-penalty game decided at even strength.
scripts.rule: a team scores >= 2 power-play goals and they are at least half of its goals

scripts.label: Tight, low-event game
scripts.summary: Few chances, strong goaltending, and a one-goal or overtime finish with four goals or fewer.
scripts.needs: Both teams defend well and neither power play converts much.
scripts.breaks: An early multi-goal lead, or either team's finishing running hot.
scripts.rule: <= 4 non-shootout goals and a one-goal final or overtime

scripts.label: Goaltending steals it
scripts.summary: One team is clearly out-shot and wins anyway behind its goaltender or opportunistic finishing.
scripts.needs: The out-shot team's goalie stops nearly everything and it converts its few chances.
scripts.breaks: The team with the territorial edge simply converts its shot volume.
scripts.rule: the winner had <= 42% of the shots on goal

scripts.label: WSH controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: WSH holds the territorial edge on the road and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: WSH out-chances OTT and converts enough to pull clear.
scripts.breaks: OTT's goalie stealing it, or OTT keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: away wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

scripts.label: Back-and-forth game
scripts.summary: A normal-scoring game with roughly even play, usually decided late or by one goal.
scripts.needs: Neither team establishes sustained control, and the score stays within reach.
scripts.breaks: Any team pulling clear with territorial control, a goalie steal, or a power-play barrage.
scripts.rule: everything not matched above (the explicit catch-all; no hidden 'other' bucket)

helps.title: New Jersey wins by over 1.5 goals

scripts.label: Open, high-event game
scripts.summary: Chances flow both ways and the scoreboard keeps moving: eight or more goals.
scripts.needs: Both offenses generate quality chances and the goaltending does not hold.
scripts.breaks: Either goalie settles in, or one team shuts the game down after taking a lead.
scripts.rule: >= 8 non-shootout goals

scripts.label: NJD controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: NJD holds the territorial edge on the road and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: NJD out-chances WPG and converts enough to pull clear.
scripts.breaks: WPG's goalie stealing it, or WPG keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: away wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

helps.title: New Jersey wins by over 1.5 goals

scripts.label: Tight, low-event game
scripts.summary: Few chances, strong goaltending, and a one-goal or overtime finish with four goals or fewer.
scripts.needs: Both teams defend well and neither power play converts much.
scripts.breaks: An early multi-goal lead, or either team's finishing running hot.
scripts.rule: <= 4 non-shootout goals and a one-goal final or overtime

scripts.label: Special teams decide it
scripts.summary: Power plays drive the scoring: one side converts repeatedly with the man advantage.
scripts.needs: Penalties pile up and one power play converts at least twice.
scripts.breaks: A clean, low-penalty game decided at even strength.
scripts.rule: a team scores >= 2 power-play goals and they are at least half of its goals

scripts.label: Goaltending steals it
scripts.summary: One team is clearly out-shot and wins anyway behind its goaltender or opportunistic finishing.
scripts.needs: The out-shot team's goalie stops nearly everything and it converts its few chances.
scripts.breaks: The team with the territorial edge simply converts its shot volume.
scripts.rule: the winner had <= 42% of the shots on goal

scripts.label: WPG controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: WPG holds the territorial edge and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: WPG out-chances NJD and converts enough to pull clear (an empty-net goal often seals it).
scripts.breaks: NJD's goalie stealing it, or NJD keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: home wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

tiers.ROBUST: adjusted EV >= 0.02 and mass survived >= 0.65 and >= 3 major scripts survived
tiers.MODERATE: adjusted EV >= 0.01 and mass survived >= 0.45 and >= 2 major scripts survived
tiers.FRAGILE: adjusted EV > 0 but below the MODERATE thresholds
tiers.DOES_NOT_SURVIVE: adjusted EV <= 0 at the executable ask
tiers.UNAVAILABLE: no executable ask, stale or crossed board, or not pregame

rules.ordering: data quality OK > not REJECTED > not FRAGILE > research score; research score = adjusted EV (c) x (0.5 + mass survived) x reliability weight x dependency factor x liquidity factor x exposure factor (x1.10 if FUNDED_RESEARCH)

taxonomy.partition: mutually exclusive by precedence; probabilities are integer draw counts and sum to 1

thresholds.provenance: a priori; aligned with thesis.scripts cut points; base rates 8-25% on 2022-23..2025-26 official finals; never fit to a slate

base_rates.source: official NHL finals (data/history/nhl games + data/history/players goals/goalies), completed regular seasons only

taxonomy.caveat: simulated shot volume comes from the goalie-saves layer with muted score effects; GOALIE_DRIVEN is expected to be under-forecast relative to history. The script calibration report measures it.

rules.conservative_probability: p_adjusted = mid + k (p - mid) (thesis.expression); per-script EV subtracts delta = p - p_adjusted from P(side | script)

scripts.label: Back-and-forth game
scripts.summary: A normal-scoring game with roughly even play, usually decided late or by one goal.
scripts.needs: Neither team establishes sustained control, and the score stays within reach.
scripts.breaks: Any team pulling clear with territorial control, a goalie steal, or a power-play barrage.
scripts.rule: everything not matched above (the explicit catch-all; no hidden 'other' bucket)

scripts.label: Open, high-event game
scripts.summary: Chances flow both ways and the scoreboard keeps moving: eight or more goals.
scripts.needs: Both offenses generate quality chances and the goaltending does not hold.
scripts.breaks: Either goalie settles in, or one team shuts the game down after taking a lead.
scripts.rule: >= 8 non-shootout goals

scripts.label: CBJ controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: CBJ holds the territorial edge and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: CBJ out-chances FLA and converts enough to pull clear (an empty-net goal often seals it).
scripts.breaks: FLA's goalie stealing it, or FLA keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: home wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

scripts.label: Special teams decide it
scripts.summary: Power plays drive the scoring: one side converts repeatedly with the man advantage.
scripts.needs: Penalties pile up and one power play converts at least twice.
scripts.breaks: A clean, low-penalty game decided at even strength.
scripts.rule: a team scores >= 2 power-play goals and they are at least half of its goals

scripts.label: Tight, low-event game
scripts.summary: Few chances, strong goaltending, and a one-goal or overtime finish with four goals or fewer.
scripts.needs: Both teams defend well and neither power play converts much.
scripts.breaks: An early multi-goal lead, or either team's finishing running hot.
scripts.rule: <= 4 non-shootout goals and a one-goal final or overtime

scripts.label: FLA controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: FLA holds the territorial edge on the road and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: FLA out-chances CBJ and converts enough to pull clear.
scripts.breaks: CBJ's goalie stealing it, or CBJ keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: away wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

scripts.label: Goaltending steals it
scripts.summary: One team is clearly out-shot and wins anyway behind its goaltender or opportunistic finishing.
scripts.needs: The out-shot team's goalie stops nearly everything and it converts its few chances.
scripts.breaks: The team with the territorial edge simply converts its shot volume.
scripts.rule: the winner had <= 42% of the shots on goal

tiers.ROBUST: adjusted EV >= 0.02 and mass survived >= 0.65 and >= 3 major scripts survived
tiers.MODERATE: adjusted EV >= 0.01 and mass survived >= 0.45 and >= 2 major scripts survived
tiers.FRAGILE: adjusted EV > 0 but below the MODERATE thresholds
tiers.DOES_NOT_SURVIVE: adjusted EV <= 0 at the executable ask
tiers.UNAVAILABLE: no executable ask, stale or crossed board, or not pregame

rules.ordering: data quality OK > not REJECTED > not FRAGILE > research score; research score = adjusted EV (c) x (0.5 + mass survived) x reliability weight x dependency factor x liquidity factor x exposure factor (x1.10 if FUNDED_RESEARCH)

taxonomy.partition: mutually exclusive by precedence; probabilities are integer draw counts and sum to 1

thresholds.provenance: a priori; aligned with thesis.scripts cut points; base rates 8-25% on 2022-23..2025-26 official finals; never fit to a slate

base_rates.source: official NHL finals (data/history/nhl games + data/history/players goals/goalies), completed regular seasons only

taxonomy.caveat: simulated shot volume comes from the goalie-saves layer with muted score effects; GOALIE_DRIVEN is expected to be under-forecast relative to history. The script calibration report measures it.

rules.conservative_probability: p_adjusted = mid + k (p - mid) (thesis.expression); per-script EV subtracts delta = p - p_adjusted from P(side | script)

scripts.label: Back-and-forth game
scripts.summary: A normal-scoring game with roughly even play, usually decided late or by one goal.
scripts.needs: Neither team establishes sustained control, and the score stays within reach.
scripts.breaks: Any team pulling clear with territorial control, a goalie steal, or a power-play barrage.
scripts.rule: everything not matched above (the explicit catch-all; no hidden 'other' bucket)

scripts.label: Open, high-event game
scripts.summary: Chances flow both ways and the scoreboard keeps moving: eight or more goals.
scripts.needs: Both offenses generate quality chances and the goaltending does not hold.
scripts.breaks: Either goalie settles in, or one team shuts the game down after taking a lead.
scripts.rule: >= 8 non-shootout goals

scripts.label: Special teams decide it
scripts.summary: Power plays drive the scoring: one side converts repeatedly with the man advantage.
scripts.needs: Penalties pile up and one power play converts at least twice.
scripts.breaks: A clean, low-penalty game decided at even strength.
scripts.rule: a team scores >= 2 power-play goals and they are at least half of its goals

scripts.label: STL controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: STL holds the territorial edge and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: STL out-chances DET and converts enough to pull clear (an empty-net goal often seals it).
scripts.breaks: DET's goalie stealing it, or DET keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: home wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

helps.title: St. Louis wins by over 1.5 goals
St. Louis wins by over 2.5 goals

scripts.label: Tight, low-event game
scripts.summary: Few chances, strong goaltending, and a one-goal or overtime finish with four goals or fewer.
scripts.needs: Both teams defend well and neither power play converts much.
scripts.breaks: An early multi-goal lead, or either team's finishing running hot.
scripts.rule: <= 4 non-shootout goals and a one-goal final or overtime

scripts.label: Goaltending steals it
scripts.summary: One team is clearly out-shot and wins anyway behind its goaltender or opportunistic finishing.
scripts.needs: The out-shot team's goalie stops nearly everything and it converts its few chances.
scripts.breaks: The team with the territorial edge simply converts its shot volume.
scripts.rule: the winner had <= 42% of the shots on goal

scripts.label: DET controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: DET holds the territorial edge on the road and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: DET out-chances STL and converts enough to pull clear.
scripts.breaks: STL's goalie stealing it, or STL keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: away wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

tiers.ROBUST: adjusted EV >= 0.02 and mass survived >= 0.65 and >= 3 major scripts survived
tiers.MODERATE: adjusted EV >= 0.01 and mass survived >= 0.45 and >= 2 major scripts survived
tiers.FRAGILE: adjusted EV > 0 but below the MODERATE thresholds

tiers.UNAVAILABLE: no executable ask, stale or crossed board, or not pregame

rules.ordering: data quality OK > not REJECTED > not FRAGILE > research score; research score = adjusted EV (c) x (0.5 + mass survived) x reliability weight x dependency factor x liquidity factor x exposure factor (x1.10 if FUNDED_RESEARCH)

taxonomy.partition: mutually exclusive by precedence; probabilities are integer draw counts and sum to 1

taxonomy.caveat: simulated shot volume comes from the goalie-saves layer with muted score effects; GOALIE_DRIVEN is expected to be under-forecast relative to history. The script calibration report measures it.

rules.conservative_probability: p_adjusted = mid + k (p - mid) (thesis.expression); per-script EV subtracts delta = p - p_adjusted from P(side | script)

scripts.label: Back-and-forth game
scripts.summary: A normal-scoring game with roughly even play, usually decided late or by one goal.
scripts.needs: Neither team establishes sustained control, and the score stays within reach.
scripts.breaks: Any team pulling clear with territorial control, a goalie steal, or a power-play barrage.
scripts.rule: everything not matched above (the explicit catch-all; no hidden 'other' bucket)

helps.title: Los Angeles wins by over 1.5 goals

scripts.label: Open, high-event game
scripts.summary: Chances flow both ways and the scoreboard keeps moving: eight or more goals.
scripts.needs: Both offenses generate quality chances and the goaltending does not hold.
scripts.breaks: Either goalie settles in, or one team shuts the game down after taking a lead.
scripts.rule: >= 8 non-shootout goals

scripts.label: LAK controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: LAK holds the territorial edge and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: LAK out-chances NSH and converts enough to pull clear (an empty-net goal often seals it).
scripts.breaks: NSH's goalie stealing it, or NSH keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: home wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

helps.title: Los Angeles wins by over 1.5 goals
Los Angeles wins by over 2.5 goals

scripts.label: Tight, low-event game
scripts.summary: Few chances, strong goaltending, and a one-goal or overtime finish with four goals or fewer.
scripts.needs: Both teams defend well and neither power play converts much.
scripts.breaks: An early multi-goal lead, or either team's finishing running hot.
scripts.rule: <= 4 non-shootout goals and a one-goal final or overtime

scripts.label: Special teams decide it
scripts.summary: Power plays drive the scoring: one side converts repeatedly with the man advantage.
scripts.needs: Penalties pile up and one power play converts at least twice.
scripts.breaks: A clean, low-penalty game decided at even strength.
scripts.rule: a team scores >= 2 power-play goals and they are at least half of its goals

scripts.label: Goaltending steals it
scripts.summary: One team is clearly out-shot and wins anyway behind its goaltender or opportunistic finishing.
scripts.needs: The out-shot team's goalie stops nearly everything and it converts its few chances.
scripts.breaks: The team with the territorial edge simply converts its shot volume.
scripts.rule: the winner had <= 42% of the shots on goal

scripts.label: NSH controls and pulls away
scripts.summary: NSH holds the territorial edge on the road and wins by two or more.
scripts.needs: NSH out-chances LAK and converts enough to pull clear.
scripts.breaks: LAK's goalie stealing it, or LAK keeping it to a one-goal game.
scripts.rule: away wins by 2+ with >= 50% of the shots on goal

tiers.ROBUST: adjusted EV >= 0.02 and mass survived >= 0.65 and >= 3 major scripts survived
tiers.MODERATE: adjusted EV >= 0.01 and mass survived >= 0.45 and >= 2 major scripts survived
tiers.FRAGILE: adjusted EV > 0 but below the MODERATE thresholds
tiers.DOES_NOT_SURVIVE: adjusted EV <= 0 at the executable ask
tiers.UNAVAILABLE: no executable ask, stale or crossed board, or not pregame

rules.ordering: data quality OK > not REJECTED > not FRAGILE > research score; research score = adjusted EV (c) x (0.5 + mass survived) x reliability weight x dependency factor x liquidity factor x exposure factor (x1.10 if FUNDED_RESEARCH)

taxonomy.partition: mutually exclusive by precedence; probabilities are integer draw counts and sum to 1

thresholds.provenance: a priori; aligned with thesis.scripts cut points; base rates 8-25% on 2022-23..2025-26 official finals; never fit to a slate

base_rates.source: official NHL finals (data/history/nhl games + data/history/players goals/goalies), completed regular seasons only

taxonomy.caveat: simulated shot volume comes from the goalie-saves layer with muted score effects; GOALIE_DRIVEN is expected to be under-forecast relative to history. The script calibration report measures it.

rules.conservative_probability: p_adjusted = mid + k (p - mid) (thesis.expression); per-script EV subtracts delta = p - p_adjusted from P(side | script)

research_governance.label: RESEARCH GOVERNANCE (not model truth): limits on FUNDED research stakes; shadow logging is unaffected

thesis_card.note: RESEARCH_ONLY thesis card: B stakes are optimiser suggestions for a nominal bankroll; R (FUNDED_RESEARCH) stakes are whole-dollar research stakes under research governance. Nothing is placed or routed. Every recommended bet is +EV at its executable ask under the model AND the confidence-adjusted probability; the card is emitted only when the completion gate passes.
